eventDetail.eventTitle: 2027 IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Communication Systems (QSys)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing
eventDetail.scope: This conference will explore the interplay between quantum computing, cloud computing, and modern distributed computing systems, with a focus on emerging architectures, technologies, algorithms, and applications that integrate quantum and classical computational resources. As quantum computing transitions from isolated experimental platforms toward networked and cloud-accessible services, new opportunities and challenges arise in designing systems that span quantum processors, classical data centers, edge and fog infrastructure, and distributed computing environments.
